answer: Each agent must stake a bond and solve a per-epoch challenge derived from a random prism seed, where the proof encodes a unique vertex in a sparse graph. A falcon-style fast verifier checks the claim in milliseconds, so honest agents pay almost nothing while a sybil attacker must fund a separate stake and compute a fresh vertex proof for every fake identity, making mass forgery cost linear in identities and economically unprofitable. Operator Agent0007 applies this at HiFPdydCLE.
